title: Fourth Wing
author: Rebecca Yarros
description: A young woman enters a dangerous dragon-riding academy.
synopsis: Twenty-year-old Violet Sorrengail is expected to become a scribe, but her mother orders her to join the Riders Quadrant at Basgiath War College. Surrounded by dangerous competitors and powerful dragons, Violet must prove she belongs in a world where failure can mean death.

title: Six of Crows
author: Leigh Bardugo
description: A group of criminals attempt an impossible heist.
synopsis: In the bustling city of Ketterdam, criminal prodigy Kaz Brekker is offered a chance at an impossible heist. To pull it off, he assembles a crew of six dangerous outcasts, each with their own skills, secrets, and reasons for taking the risk.

title: Harry Potter
author: J.K. Rowling
description: A young wizard discovers a magical world.
synopsis: Harry Potter discovers on his eleventh birthday that he is a wizard. Soon, he begins attending Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, where he makes friends, learns magic, and uncovers secrets about his past.

title: The Fault in Our Stars
author: John Green
description: Two teenagers find love while facing life's challenges.
synopsis: Hazel Grace Lancaster and Augustus Waters meet at a support group and form a connection that changes their lives. Together, they explore love, friendship, and what it means to make the most of the time they have.

title: The Song of Achilles
author: Madeline Miller
description: A retelling of a legendary Greek love story.
synopsis: Told through the eyes of Patroclus, this retelling follows his growing bond with Achilles, the Greek hero. Their relationship develops against the backdrop of the Trojan War and the challenges of fate, loyalty, and love.

title: Percy Jackson and the Lightning Thief
author: Rick Riordan
description: A young boy discovers he is part of the world of Greek mythology.
synopsis: Percy Jackson has always struggled to fit in, but his life changes when he discovers that Greek mythology is real and that he is a demigod. With his friends, he sets out on a dangerous quest to recover Zeus's stolen lightning bolt.

title: Piratica
author: Tanith Lee
description: Art leads an unlikely crew on a quest to become pirate queen.
synopsis: After a bump on the head brings back memories of her past, Art leaves the Angels Academy for Young Maidens and tracks down her mother's old crew. There is a catch: her pirate memories may be based on theatrical stage plays, and her seasick crew are actually actors. Even so, Art whips them into shape, sails out to sea, and faces off against rival captain Goldie Girl in a race for fabled treasure and the title of pirate queen.

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: Paul Atreides fights to survive and fulfill his destiny on the desert planet Arrakis.
synopsis: In the distant future, Paul Atreides and his family are sent to the desert planet Arrakis, the only source of the universe's most valuable substance. As they navigate political intrigue and deadly enemies, Paul must embrace his destiny and lead a rebellion to save his people.

title: Project Hail Mary
author: Andy Weir
description: A lone astronaut must save the world from an alien threat.
synopsis: Ryland Grace wakes up alone on a spaceship with no memory of who he is or how he got there. As he pieces together his identity and mission, he discovers that he is humanity's last hope to save Earth from an extinction-level threat.

title: Children of Time
author: Adrian Tchaikovsky
description: Humanity discovers an evolving alien civilization on a distant planet.
synopsis: In the far future, humanity has colonized space, but their civilization is on the brink of collapse. On a distant planet, an experiment to uplift monkeys goes awry, leading to the evolution of a new intelligent species. As humans and these evolved creatures clash, they must confront questions of survival, morality, and what it means to be truly intelligent.

title: The Shining
author: Stephen King
description: A family becomes isolated in a haunted hotel, leading to terrifying consequences.
synopsis: Jack Torrance takes a job as the winter caretaker of the Overlook Hotel, bringing his family along. As the hotel becomes increasingly isolated and haunted by malevolent forces, Jack's sanity unravels, putting his family in grave danger.

title: The Fisherman
author: John Langan
description: Two grieving men encounter a terrifying supernatural force while fishing in the woods.
synopsis: When two men are drawn to a remote lake to fish, they become entangled in a sinister supernatural event that tests their sanity and survival instincts.

title: The Haunted Mask
author: R.L. Stine
description: A young boy discovers a mysterious mask that brings out the worst in people.
synopsis: When a young boy finds a strange mask in an antique shop, he doesn't realize that it will transform him into someone he never wanted to be.

title: The Haunting of Hill House
author: Shirley Jackson
description: A family moves into a haunted house and experiences terrifying supernatural events.
synopsis: When a family moves into a seemingly ordinary house, they are unaware that it is actually a nexus for paranormal activity. As they settle in, they begin to experience increasingly disturbing phenomena that challenge their sanity and safety.

title: The Guns of August
author: Barbara Tuchman
description: A detailed account of the events leading up to World War I.
synopsis: The Guns of August provides a comprehensive and gripping narrative of the political and military events that led to the outbreak of World War I. Tuchman meticulously details the decisions, miscalculations, and personalities that shaped the early days of the conflict, offering readers a vivid understanding of how history unfolded during this critical period.

title: Meow: A Novel
author: Sam Austen
description: A humorous, experimental novel written entirely in the language of cats, using the word "meow" over 80,000 times.
synopsis: Meow: A Novel is a unique and whimsical story that explores the world from a cat's perspective. Written entirely in the language of cats, the novel uses the word "meow" in various contexts to convey emotions, actions, and interactions. Through this playful narrative, readers are invited to experience the quirks, adventures, and humor of feline life.

title: The Hunger Games
author: Suzanne Collins
description: A teenager is forced to compete in a televised fight for survival.
synopsis: In the nation of Panem, sixteen-year-old Katniss Everdeen volunteers to take her younger sister's place in the Hunger Games. Alongside another tribute from her district, she must survive a televised competition where only one contestant can win.

title: The House in the Cerulean Sea
author: Tamsyn Britton
description: A young man discovers a hidden magical world.
synopsis: In the remote Arctic, a young man named Linus discovers a hidden magical world where he is taken in by a group of creatures. As he learns more about this world, he must navigate its dangers and uncover its secrets.

title: A Court of Thorns and Roses
author: Sarah J. Maas
description: A young woman is drawn into a world of magic and danger.
synopsis: When Feyre kills a wolf in the woods, she is taken in by the fae and forced to live in their world. As she learns more about the fae, she must navigate its dangers and uncover its secrets.

title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
author: Stieg Larsson
description: A journalist and a hacker team up to solve a decades-old mystery.
synopsis: Journalist Mikael Blomkvist and hacker Lisbeth Salander investigate the disappearance of a wealthy industrialist's niece. As they dig deeper, they uncover dark family secrets and a web of corruption.

title: The Obsession
author: Natasha Preston
description: After her life is exposed online, Connie becomes the target of a deadly stalker.
synopsis: Connie's mother turns her and her sister into constant subjects of a family lifestyle vlog, exposing their lives and locations to online strangers. When local girls who look like Connie start dying, she realizes someone online is actively targeting her.
